messages:
tanya: FYI: multiple customers reported short-term duplicated token charges when streams reconnect after the proxy rollout. Low volume but visible.
kevin: Which region/routes? logs?
tanya: Mostly eu-west and us-east, long-lived SSE clients. spikes around 11:03 UTC.
ops-bot: [ALERT] streaming.duplicate_token_rate eu-west > 0.15% at 1764445559
sasha: On the console route timeline I can see resume attempts coinciding with proxy fence events. Suggest adding a resume-level trace in the UI.
raul: Logs show ordering where billing-emitter records a resume charge before proxy fence is performed: 
```
[11:03:12] proxy-a resume id=r123 forwarded
[11:03:12] billing-emitter emit resume_charge id=r123 tokens=75
[11:03:12] proxy-a respond 204 fence=1
[11:03:13] client reconnect resubscribe offset=0
```
maria: Short-term mitigation: add a 500-800ms jitter before proxy sends 204 in canary. Mid-term: server-side resume idempotency check and billing guard.
kevin: I'll open a proxy config PR with a feature flag for delayed-204 in canary (5%). Also will add resume_attempt and resume_charge metrics to Grafana.
tanya: I'll update the runbook and notify support. ops-bot, start a tracker.
ops-bot: [INCIDENT] STREAM-INC-2027 created at 1764445680
kevin: Canary deploying now. Watching duplicate_token_rate and resume_outcome metrics.
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] proxy-canary delayed-204 5% started at 1764445720
kevin: initial canary numbers: duplicate_rate down to 0.04% in canary shards. Will bake 45m then roll.
